name: Empire of Heroes
source:
Empire of Heroes is an adult visual novel (male protagonist) set in a world of heroes and villains, where nearly every human on Earth has some kind of superpower. You'll dive into a story full of mystery, action, romance, drama, comedy and much more. Oh, and don't worry, there is a lot of good stuff for all you man of culture out there.

[From [url=https://lucyfar.itch.io/empire-of-heroes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《英雄帝国》是一部成人视觉小说（男主角），背景设定在一个充满英雄和恶棍的世界，地球上几乎每个人都拥有某种超能力。你将深入了解一个充满神秘、动作、浪漫、戏剧、喜剧等的故事。哦，别担心，这里有很多好东西适合你们所有的文化人。

[来自[url=https://lucyfar.itch.io/empire-of-heroes]Itch.io[/url]]
